TRANSFER OF ($ 42,000.000.00) FORTY TWO MILLION, CREDITS.
I'm SERGIO ALVAREZ, the general manager of LAS PARADES REGIONAL BANK, here in Val Verde. A client of mine JOHN ROVOKO died in the Oceanic Airline 404 plane crash near Margaret Bay and has a fortune.

This money can only be approved to a foreigner with an intercontinental passport. I need your assurance that you will never cheat me as soon as this fund hit into your account. On the conclusion of this transaction you will be entitled to 30% of the total sum. I want you to forward to me your full name, contact address and phone number
